notes.title: 📰 The Ahra Prime Times – Week 2
notes.content:
🗞️ The Ahra Prime Times — Weekly Edition
Status: Migration to UE 5.6.1, stability in progress. Hiraeth  breathes deeper.


👋 Greetings, Survivors of Ahra Prime

🔧 Work on the New Engine
Here’s an update on the ongoing transition to the latest version of Unreal Engine. This change brings many benefits — both for players and for me as the developer.

Crashes in officially confirmed cases have been fully eliminated by new engine version. Temporary freezes may still occur in critical situations — a major step forward, though we’re still waiting for more! My tests, along with those from other players, show improved engine optimization. You may not always notice it directly, but both rendering and world streaming have significantly improved.

I’m also seeing many positive changes in the editor — the project compiles faster. This directly improves workflow comfort, which in turn means better development pace and quality for Hiraeth going forward.


✅ What’s been achieved in the migration? What’s next?
As I mentioned last week (Steam Announcement), I’ve resolved the issue with HLOD building in the new engine version — a key milestone for our open-world game. This means a major stage related to rendering, its stability, and performance has been successfully completed.

But rendering isn’t everything — especially in a game with mechanics as complex as Hiraeth. The new engine version introduces a different approach to class inheritance, requiring major changes. I’m nearly done — almost everything works again, but “almost” is the difference that’s holding back the next update.

These changes also affect the save/load system — a core part of the game. That’s currently taking up most of my time.

Let me add: the time required for these tasks isn’t due to the team being just one person — me. These are deep system-level tasks that would still need to be handled by one person overseeing the whole structure. A larger team wouldn’t help at this stage.


🖥️ Game Requirements — Regardless of Engine Version
The issues discussed on certain hardware setups are rare, but they pose serious challenges for the project’s future. Solving them may take a few more days — or slightly longer — which is frustrating.

Until now, I’ve been resolving game bugs through regular updates. I hope that rhythm returns soon so we can continue developing the game and Ahra Prime faster and further.


🎮 Stable 60 FPS in 4K?
Many players ask why they don’t get a minimum of 60 FPS on good hardware.

Hiraeth’s performance is comparable — or even better — than other well-known open-world games using similar technology. Average for RTX 4080 is from 30 to 65 FPS — without DLSS, which I’ll be adding soon after other issues are resolved.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/86a4afd36200e95510868d03c7a896ab4e432425.png"]

One of our players currently achieves stable 60 FPS on high-end hardware: CPU: Ryzen 5 7600 RAM: 64 GB DDR5 GPU: Radeon 7900 XTX 24 GB

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/d81f56f7c94e9afc7e77a5257bd4d2d0ac8cf18a.png"]

As for me — I can only dream of such performance on my RTX 2060. But despite having a relatively weak card by today’s standards, I experience no stability issues, and the game runs smoothly enough that I play on Epic settings.

Confirmed issues across different hardware configurations are described here: 🔗 Steam Discussion and confirmation here.


🆕 When’s the New Version Coming?
I hope to release new updates for Early Access and the demo in the coming days. The project has gone through several versions since the last changes, but they still need refinement. That’s why I’m releasing a test version for the demo — important for the entire project. It’s the same build — the demo just has many limitations. What works in the demo will work in Early Access.

If you’re interested, join us on Discord — I regularly share work-in-progress builds there. Many of these versions allow for hours of gameplay, but they require preparation — like frequent downloads or deleting old saves.
🧰 Changes and Fixes (Not Yet Published on Steam)
Fixed backpack overload bug that prevented re-equipping after dropping

Removed infinite ladder climbing exploit

New loading screen after save/load and improved startup visuals — still needs minor polish

New system for checking player and world state after load

Containers like cargo crates now have realistic weight limits — 100 kg instead of 10 kg

…and many more. Some of these changes are already in Demo version 0.9.7.5 Experimental — see below.


🧪 Experimental Branch
The experimental branch announced last week has been created on Steam, but it’s currently empty and hidden. I don’t want to complicate updates — it will go live after the official stable update on the new engine is released.


🧪 Demo v 0.9.7.5 Experimental — Stability Test Download
Who is it for?

Players who experienced crashes during gameplay or right after launching on Nesoi Island

Anyone curious about performance improvements from the upcoming engine migration

Limitations:

Save/load is completely disabled in this version

Work on proper save functionality in the new engine is ongoing — it’s not part of this test

Test Objective: This version is meant for short testing — to check whether Lumen or Nanite-related crashes have been resolved. Epic — the creator of Unreal Engine — seems to have fixed many previous issues in this area, and testers confirm it. But we need broader confirmation across various hardware setups.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/636570ffe2d80ddb25bc5f40a9eb49b43f7a749f.png"]

Longer play sessions may expose bugs — especially painful ones due to the lack of save/load. So once again: this version is for short testing — to verify rendering changes in the new engine.

📥 Download from Google Drive


🏆 Contest Results — Ancient Figurine: Winner FLPX86
Last week’s contest has a winner — the only player who submitted a complete and correct answer: FLPX86 They received a Steam key for Hiraeth and a special Discord role.

🔗 Winning submission on Discord
🗿 Ancient Figurine — Functions and Properties
When released from a container (chest, backpack), it generates enough breathable air nearby

Enables breathing in oxygen-free environments

Research doesn’t clearly confirm whether it truly generates air — but its effects on instruments and living organisms are verified

Emits low-level radiation — prolonged exposure may be harmful

Difficult to grab, yet easy to store — its nature remains mysterious

No device has been successfully created to allow safe, mobile use — radiation halted development

Occurrence: Ancient Figurines and similar artifacts are known but extremely rare on Ahra Prime

Origin: Still unknown

Use case: Useful for sleeping in caves or under open skies to conserve oxygen

Warning: Due to negative effects, should only be used for short naps in critical situations or during stationary work outside safe zones


🏁 New Contest — Training Center: Speed Run
I hope the tradition of weekly contests continues! This week’s challenge is open to all — Early Access and Demo players alike.
🕹️ Training Center — Speed Run
Rules:

The fastest training completion time wins

Submission deadline: Friday, September 26

Screenshot of training completion required — post it here: #contest-submissions 🏆

Only the core training needs to be completed — no side objectives

You may record a video and upload it to YouTube (unlisted) — if you win, I’ll feature it in the next edition of The Ahra Prime Times

Prizes:

Steam key for Early Access

Special Discord role

My own tutorial run is just an example — much faster times are possible. It takes game knowledge and a bit of strategy. Good luck!

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Y1sijrXRB4"][/dynamiclink]


Thank You! ːss2heartː 
Thanks to everyone who tests, reports, supports, and plays. Ahra Prime lives because of you — and I’m doing everything I can to keep its heart beating stronger.

See you in the next edition! — Paweł

notes.title: 👨🏻‍🚀 Testing the Game on Unreal Engine 5.6.1 — Call for Help
notes.content:
👋 Welcome, Traveler
HIRAETH Needs You — Final Test Before the Patch Goes Live


Following up on yesterday’s announcement: testing is underway for the game running on Unreal Engine 5.6.1 — the latest version, which addresses several memory overflow issues and crashes, even on high-end devices.

✅ Initial tests show full success. My own multi-hour playthrough on Nesoi Island ran flawlessly. Internal testing on different hardware also confirmed stability.


🧪 Before releasing this version as a Steam update, I need broader testing — especially on devices that previously experienced crashes after loading Nesoi Island.

👨🏻‍🚀 Call for Testers
If you’ve encountered the issues mentioned above, I’d greatly appreciate your help testing this closed version — download link is at the bottom. The sooner we get confirmation, the sooner the official patch can go live on Steam. If you haven’t had any issues with the current version (based on the previous Unreal Engine build), there’s no need to test this one.


ℹ️ Important Info Before You Download:
This is a demo version. I can’t publish the full Early Access build, but technically it’s the same project — enough to confirm the fix.

Please save your game by sleeping wherever possible (see map below).

This version is intended solely for crash testing. It’s a raw build with default Unreal Engine settings — performance may be slightly heavier, but crashes should not occur.

Many players experienced crashes right at the start of Nesoi Island. For a complete test, please follow the marked route — it includes a critical area that very rarely, but even for me, caused a crash (no in this version).

The dangerous zone is small, but I’ve marked an extended area just to be safe. The issue stemmed from an Unreal Engine bug in earlier versions. According to the changelog, it should be resolved in 5.6.1 — which my video test confirms.

The game content is the same as before — only the build has changed, now running on the new engine version.

Migrating to the new engine required some updates, which I’ve already implemented. It allows over 2 hours of gameplay on Nesoi Island, but I haven’t tested everything — feel free to report anything else. The main goal is to confirm whether the game crashes on your hardware or not.

Aside from the engine update, this version is identical to the current Steam release.
* Annoucement update
If you couldn't start Nesoi at all before and now you can play normally, I think confirming this will be enough - the full route and a longer test will be super helpful, but even such a short test will be very useful!

notes.title: 🪐 HIRAETH — Early Access: Launch Recap & What’s Next
notes.content:
Launch Recap • Sales & Support • Recent Updates • Crash Fix Progress • Community Feedback • What’s Next • Closing Words
Hello Survivors of Ahra Prime — brave pioneers of Early Access!
Welcome aboard, and thank you for being part of this unfolding journey. Your presence means everything.

On September 3rd, our shared journey to Ahra Prime officially began. I want to thank everyone who joined HIRAETH in Early Access — especially those who understand what this phase of development truly means. As a solo developer working on such a complex project, I deeply appreciate every piece of feedback, every bug report, and every moment you spend in the world of HIRAETH.

🎮 ☵ HIRAETH had its initial testing phase as a Steam Playtest, but it’s only now — in Early Access — that the game has truly come alive. Player activity has increased dramatically, and the median playtime speaks for itself. I’ve received tons of valuable feedback from thoughtful players who understand that Early Access isn’t just about playing early — it’s about building the game together. This is the stage where bugs are identified and fixed, new features are tested, and gameplay is refined based on real player experiences. It’s clear that HIRAETH has landed in the right hands — and that gives me huge motivation to keep going.


📊 Sales Report — Straight Talk
HIRAETH was created and released without any funding for advertising. The only investment was my time — and the incredible support from YouTubers who specialize in survival games, some of whom had already featured HIRAETH on their channels. I’m truly grateful to them and want to thank them here.

Because of that, sales may not look impressive on paper — but to me, it’s a huge success. It allows me to continue developing the game at the pace you’ve seen since launch.

Big titles often need massive revenue upfront to cover marketing costs and large teams. In HIRAETH’s case, every cent goes directly into development. If more players join the journey, I’ll gladly expand the team — which will help development move even faster.

A lot depends on you — your Steam reviews and word-of-mouth recommendations. If funds allow, I’ll invest in promotion too, which will definitely help the game reach more players and evolve further.


🔧 What’s Already Happened
The demo and pre-launch testing helped lay a solid foundation.

Daily updates (0.9.7.x) have improved many aspects of the game — from UI to stability.

New features added just before Early Access have been well received:

Mini-games: hacking, lockpicking, repairing

A new base to explore: Comm Center

And many other improvements

Some of these additions introduced minor but annoying bugs — but fixing them is just a matter of time. After three years of solo development, I can confidently say we’re on the right track.


⚠️ Stability Issues on Some Devices — Fix in Progress
Player reports helped identify rare but serious crash issues — especially on specific hardware configurations. This is currently my top priority.

In response, I’ve migrated the project to Unreal Engine 5.6.1, which in early testing has shown that the crashes are resolved. This version still needs internal testing before it’s released on Steam as an official update — but it’s coming soon.

If you’re experiencing crashes and enjoy testing — join us on Discord and contact me. I’ll share internal test builds using UE 5.6.1. The more devices we test on, the faster we can solve this globally.

Thank you for your patience — the fix is on the horizon.


💬 Your Feedback Matters
There’s a lot of emotion in the comments — especially from those who’ve run into technical issues. At the same time, I know many of you are enjoying the game and sharing positive feedback on Discord, forums, and elsewhere.

Many of you — even though it’s only been a few days since launch — have already spent hours immersed in the game. That’s incredibly motivating for me, and it’s just the beginning of what’s coming your way.

If you’re enjoying HIRAETH, please leave a review on Steam. It’s the only form of promotion I have right now — and it directly affects how fast and far the game can grow.


🚀 What’s Next
Fixing current bugs and crash issues — that’s the first step.

A new region to explore, vehicles, and a difficulty progression system — already in development.

Save system for the Training Center, and fixes for save/load bugs (like duplicated items, medkits, and oxygen tanks).

A detailed roadmap will be announced once the new Unreal Engine version is confirmed stable.

Thanks again for being part of this journey. Stay curious, stay safe on Ahra Prime — and see you in the next update!

Warm regards, Paweł Solo developer & creator of ☵ HIRAETH

* solo for now — but with your support, that might change soon!

notes.title: 🛠️ Early Access Patch 0.9.7.3 – Gameplay Fixes & First Experimental Level
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here comes what’s probably the fourth round of fixes since launch last week — and this one tackles a few of the more frustrating bugs you’ve reported. Let’s dive in:
🔧 Changelog Highlights:
Hacking Timeout UI Freeze Fixed The UI freeze after hacking timeout has been resolved. Last Saturday’s update introduced several improvements to mini-games, but I missed a bug that caused the UI and interactions to freeze when hacking timed out. That issue is now fixed. (I still feel like something else might have slipped through, but I haven’t found it in reports or been able to reproduce it — let me know if you notice anything.)

Fix for Heavy Backpack Pickup Logic The system now correctly checks whether the player can lift an item based on their current max lift. This prevents picking up a backpack that was too heavy to carry and had just been dropped. Note: Weapon and armor weight checks are coming in a separate patch soon.

Air Tank & Battery Swap Bug Fixed Swapping items like Air Tanks didn’t immediately show them as detached in the inventory, which could cause minor confusion. That’s fixed. Also improved behavior on chargers — please report if anything still seems off.

🏆 Steam Achievements Update

Achievements at the Training Center are now only granted upon completing the full training sequence (Note: this requires confirmation of proper functionality — please report any issues)

Achievements should now be disabled in the new Space Test level (This zone is purely for testing and not part of the main progression)

As a rule, Steam achievements are intended to be available only on Tha Nesoi Island, the main game area

If you unlock an achievement in Space Test... well, that’s probably a bug. Or a sign you’re too clever. Please report it.

Chargers Improvements

Fixed a bug where drinking while filling water could freeze the menu. You can now grab a bottle without preview or drink directly from the charger.

Items on chargers now support quick inventory addition. This will soon be available for all items — previews will be optional or only shown for unknown items, depending on your looter level.

Chargers now show USE instead of OPEN when accessible.

Weapons No Longer Jam When Clean & Condition > 90% Weapons should now behave more reliably. Previously, even a 100% clean weapon could jam due to frustrating randomness — calculations were correct, but the experience wasn’t. This is now toned down. (A bigger weapon update is coming soon.)

Reduced Pushback Force on Player Collisions This is part of a new system still in progress, but early tweaks should feel better.

Other Small Fixes

Materials updated for vests, plates, some bags, and backpacks

Added an option to disable interaction immediately after waking up

Crafting UI: “TOOL” label changed to “PLACE AND SELECT A REQUIRED TOOL” to reduce confusion
🧪 New Early Access Test Level: “Space Test” (EA Only)
A new experimental level added just for internal testing — but since it’s already in-game, why not share it with the bravest testers?

A small, minimalistic room packed with crates and devices for hacking, repairing, and lockpicking — all workbenches included

Weapons and wildlife (non-hostile) — yes, even the spiders purr sweetly if you listen closely

Sleeping and cooking stations available

Great for practicing mechanics like hacking — and once the upcoming weapon update drops, you’ll be able to test those differences too

Note: Items from this level can’t be transferred to Nesoi Island — blame the damn customs regulations

Achievements are disabled in this zone

This level was originally created for internal testing only, but if it’s well received, I’ll gladly polish it further in my spare time

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/30ff1e30aea42a988d15d9de64712d8ed5f1fec7.png"]
Coming soon: another small test level called The Impact Crater. Neither of these are part of the main game storyline... probably 😉 (After all, the game takes place on a planet — not a space station like Space Test — but hey, maybe there’s more to it.)
🧪 What’s Coming Soon (likely this week):
Performance improvements are near ready, but still untested. I didn’t want to mix them into this patch, so they’ll come separately — and we might roll back if needed

A dedicated fix for save/load issues: some items are appearing after load that shouldn’t. It doesn’t break the game, but it hurts immersion

I'm finishing work on adding save/load functionality to the Training Center

More bug fixes are on the way, as always

Weapon improvements probably won’t land this week — but I’m not ruling it out

The demo will be updated to this version soon — possibly later today or tomorrow


Thanks for all your feedback and support — keep it coming!

Warm regards, The Developer

notes.title: 🔧 EA update 0.9.7.2 — Performance Tweaks & UI Fixes (mini-games)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today’s update may seem small at first glance, but your feedback will directly influence how I approach future optimization.
✅ Fixes:
Resolved a bug that could lock the UI during mini-games:

Hacking

Lockpicking

Repairing
⚙️ Performance: Updated rendering and streaming behavior
This change mainly affects Nesoi Island — specifically how textures and world objects are loaded in the open environment. Recently, I noticed FPS drops at the start of the game. These weren’t caused by scene complexity, but rather by how the engine handles world loading. Earlier builds performed better, though they had other minor issues. I’d love to hear your feedback — especially on Discord — about which version runs better for you.

⚠️ Note: Textures and LOD at game start You may notice blurred textures or incorrect LODs when the game first loads. I can force high-quality loading from the start, but I’m not sure it’s necessary for all hardware setups.

In the future, I plan to add settings that let players choose how textures are streamed and how GPU memory is managed. For now, I’m working on finding a universal default that works well across most systems.
🔜 What’s Next?
Investigating a bug causing item duplication in the world and on hangars

Backpack can be overloaded, and dropped items may not be picked up properly

Several smaller fixes and improvements are also on my list and will be addressed soon

For more details, join the Discord event this Sunday — I’ll be sharing updates and answering questions live. Check the event link for your local time.


Thanks again for your support and feedback!

Warm regards,
Paweł — creator of Hiraeth

notes.title: 🛠️ Early Access Launch — Welcome to Hiraeth!
notes.content:
Hello to all Early Access participants — current and future!
I had planned a longer announcement to celebrate the launch, but the truth is: I’m still deep in development and simply don’t have the time. I hope you’ll agree that steady progress and a stable Early Access build are more important than a fancy post.

Just yesterday, on launch day, I released the first patch — and another one might drop tomorrow. Right now, my main focus is tackling a new issue: FPS drops.
🎯 Performance Improvements
Over the past few months, performance was looking great. Unfortunately, the final builds leading up to Early Access introduced some issues. I went a bit overboard with settings — and with so many interdependent systems, it’s not a simple fix. But I’m already working on it, and performance will soon return to previous levels.

On my RTX 2060, the game ran smoothly, and on stronger cards, even better. That’s the experience I’m aiming to restore.

Hiraeth uses cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5.5 features: Ray Tracing, Nanite, World Partition, Lumen. It’s unlikely to run well on older GPUs. I may consider a version optimized for lower-end hardware in the future, but that’s not part of the current roadmap — and it might not be necessary at all.
🗺️ Roadmap for 2025
The current version includes many features added just recently — which is impressive, considering the project has been in development for 3 years. Here are a few highlights:

Skill leveling and progression (added this summer)

Inventory with drag & drop (since May)

Mini-games: hacking, lockpicking, repair (coming this summer)

Steam achievements — implemented during the demo phase, less than a month ago

Updates are released regularly, and most issues with these features are nearly resolved. Soon, they’ll be running smoothly.
🔫 What’s Next in 2025?
Weapons will be refined — both in terms of handling and overall mechanics. Melee weapons will be added shortly after (or possibly even before).

The design of Nesoi Island will be finalized — including surface and underwater areas. New caves will be added, and previously inaccessible buildings will be opened.

This year, I plan to introduce the first vehicle and a brand-new region: Ahra Prime — with a different environment and unique biomes.

New gameplay elements are also on the horizon: the first quests and mission systems will be introduced, along with interactive tasks and objectives. I’m also exploring the addition of player-controlled farming and building power systems — features that could open up entirely new layers of immersion and strategy.
🤝 True Early Access — Solo Developer
Hiraeth is a genuine Early Access title developed by a solo dev. If more players join the journey, I’ll be able to bring others on board to help — which would ease the workload and speed up development.

Today’s post is just a brief look at what’s ahead. For more details, join the Discord event this Sunday — I’ll be sharing updates and answering questions live. Check the event link for your local time.


Thanks for being here and supporting the project.
Warm regards,
Paweł — creator of Hiraeth

🧪 Why Play Now?
It’s not just a test — it’s co-creation.

Players have a real impact on the game’s development.

Feedback from the demo directly shapes future updates.

It’s a chance to be there “from the beginning” — before Hiraeth becomes something bigger.


🌌 The World of Hiraeth — Maybe It’s for You?
I don’t know who you are. But if Hiraeth stirred even one string inside you — maybe this game was made for you. Not for the masses. For you. And that’s enough.

I’m not interested in flashy exposition. I care about experience. I want players to feel lost, yet intrigued. To discover rules, rhythm, and meaning on their own. Not everything will be handed to you — but everything will make sense.


🛤️ What’s Next? Roadmap and Development
The current demo is just a taste of what’s coming. On September 3, Early Access begins — bringing new mechanics, expanded world content, and many features not available in the demo, such as skill progression beyond level 2, difficulty selection, and much more.

Early Access marks the beginning of the journey toward full release, which will be rolled out in two interconnected modes:

☵ ETERNAL — sandbox survival mode

☵ REVELATIONS — story-driven mode

The game world — the wild planet Ahra Prime — will gradually expand. The Nesoi Island you explore in the demo is just a small fragment of a much larger universe.


💻 Platforms and Support
After the Early Access launch, versions for Linux, SteamOS, and macOS are planned — as promised from the start. Controller support is also coming, and may be available even before September 3.


🌍 Languages and Community
Technical preparations are underway to introduce additional language versions. At the same time, integration with Steam Workshop is in progress, initially focused on enabling community translations — alongside official ones. This will make Hiraeth accessible to players around the world.

All these changes will gradually be reflected in the demo as well — with regular updates.


📖 Is the Demo Part of a Larger Story?
Yes. In the demo, you’ll find notes and fragments that introduce you to the ☵ HIRAETH universe. They don’t yet affect gameplay — but that will change soon. Narrative elements will begin to weave into the experience, even within the demo.


🎮 Hiraeth Is True Indie — In Its Purest Form
Many games labeled “indie” today are backed by publishers, investors, large teams, and comfortable budgets. Hiraeth doesn’t belong to that category.

This game is built from the ground up by one person — me. While the credits include a few names of people who helped at different stages (and I’m deeply grateful to them), their contributions are just a fraction of this three-year journey. I’m not saying this to stand out — I’m saying it so you understand the challenge I’m facing. And how much I care about making this game real.

You’ll also find the names of people who supported the project financially. Though the funds were modest, they saved me from having to pause development more than once. Thanks to them, Hiraeth has reached this stage.

Playtesters have also played a huge role. I’ve had a clear vision from the start, but their feedback is invaluable. Thanks to them, Hiraeth gets better with every version. Thank you.


☵ HIRAETH — A Game Born from the Need to Tell Something True
I don’t have a team. I have an idea, stubbornness, and some coffee. And that has to be enough. But even modest success in Early Access could change that.

With minimal resources — just enough for basic infrastructure and symbolic compensation for a few creators — Hiraeth could accelerate in ways currently beyond my reach. I’m not an expert in everything. And I don’t need to be. I need space to focus on what I truly do best: world design, environmental storytelling, and crafting engaging gameplay.

Let musicians make music. Let 3D artists build spaces. I want to create Hiraeth — the way it’s meant to be. It’s not about a big team. It’s about a few good people who can help this game breathe fully.


🤝 Join, Support, Share
💬 Join the community on Discord

⭐ Add Hiraeth to your Steam Wishlist

📝 Share your thoughts — every message matters


🌟 Final Words — Thank You! 
Thank you to everyone who played the demo, shared feedback, supported the project, or simply showed interest. Your presence, thoughts, and encouragement mean the world to me. It’s because of you that Hiraeth lives and has the chance to grow.

TL;DR Yes, this announcement might be a bit “Too Long; Didn’t Read” for some — but Hiraeth isn’t your typical arcade game. It’s a unique experience that asks for focus, reflection, and emotional presence. This is your journey — and this game is being made for you.

With warm regards, Paweł Tomkowiak — creator of ☵ HIRAETH

notes.title: Big changes in ☵ HIRAETH game - Demo and Early Access coming!
notes.content:
Game News & Progress
Here, on the game's website, updates and announcements are sporadic. However, playtest participants have a separate Steamcommunity where they appear with each update ☵ HIRAETH game Steam Playtest. I encourage everyone to join Playtest, these are the last days. Recently, the playtest has been completely free, it does not require my approval. As usual, I strongly encourage you and your friends to add ☵ HIRAETH to your Steam wishlist.

This is of great importance for promoting the game and not wasting its potential! The game will be released in Early Access after reaching a minimum of 10,000 wishlists, which is necessary for its proper visibility at the time of premiere. Proper promotion, recognition and success will provide me with the opportunity to develop and refine it as planned. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646160/Hiraeth/"][/dynamiclink]
Some statistics
Work on the game has been ongoing since August 2023. The project is currently in the pre-Early Access stage, which is not a bad result for a game this extensive and created by practically one person.

A modest but playable closed playtest was launched on December 7, 2023, and since June last year it has been available to the public, after acceptance - for a few days now, as I mentioned, it has been completely free.
Playtest Participants and Wishlists
Up until May of this year, around 1400 players participated in the playtest from the beginning and the game had around 1500 wishlists. Currently, over 3000 players participate in the playtest and the game has over 4300 wishlists.

This is a great acceleration and motivates me to work even more!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/92197b44683e1593fbdd9d4268411e816edb8ebb.png"]
Changes in the Playtest version only in the last half year
Work on the game is most often visible in the playtest, although I do not include everything because not everything requires testing. Significant changes in the last half a year:

dynamic weather system, also with an impact on gameplay;

mature save load system;

creatures - the ability to defend and hunt;

chargers: oxygen tanks, batteries and a water filler;

new weapons with degradation and repair functions;

complete change of inventory management, now using drag and drop;

player armor;

different types of stoves;

the ability to swim and dive!

This is only a short and incomplete list of what's new.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th]

[/th][th]

[/th][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/2bc009e8277f024a074669d8247e31e25b584162.png"]Game UI - Operator tab
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/5fe1d2bb7ed0b605cb1d8beef7e16fdfa3becb5b.png"]The Nesoi Isand
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/c076c7c60bfecf4f783c376bef018f8f0a75a261.png"]The Nesoi Isand
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/626f4de72e2a5181deec2ef549f7fbfa278fb6af.png"]Large base, social room
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/a8e425b9597a92ac084657a4d11ca864d64584c3.png"]Diving view
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/eb82e00746c7bd9d86f965e7a14d1b77154cc281.png"]Investigation of the sunken transport ship
[/td][/tr][/table]Playtest changes coming soon – it will end and will be replaced by beta testing
The open Steam Playtest of the game will soon come to an end in its current form. Recently, there has been a lot of (for a single-player game) participation, which is great and very helpful for the development of the game.

The Playtest will soon turn into a beta test, which will be accessible only to active and regularly reporting testers ☵ HIRAETH and supporters of the project on Patreon, Buymeacoffee and PayPal. The playtest itself in its current form will disappear when the game demo is released.

The playtest as it stands now will likely be closed at the beginning of July, with the release of the Demo.
☵ HIRAETH Game Demo
The game's Demo should appear in July. It will be a development demo, showing more or less the state of the game in the Early Access version and will be updated on an ongoing basis. A separate demo will appear for the later version of the full game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/cf8a87d324442db836c1eba6c72c04077e0a4c04.jpg"]
Demo limitations and differences from the game
language versions will appear in the demo gradually, the first version will definitely come out with an English interface, other languages ​​will be added gradually;

the demo should have its own key settings, and controller support next;

the demo will come out in a Windows version, then a Linux version, for macOS probably later, after the Early Access version is released;

limitations and the ability to save load is an open question, especially since in the game it will be related to the choice of the difficulty level, which will not be in the early demo;

one universal difficulty level, maybe others will be added later;

in the demo there will be only one default character to choose from, as currently in playtest;

A separate Steam page for the demo should appear in the next few days, but it will be available for download at the end of this month or next month.
Early AccessWhat's in the Early Access version?
Currently, the expectations of players, Steam and popularizers have changed significantly in the last few years. A few years ago, ☵ HIRAETH could have been released at the level it was at half a year ago and no one would be surprised. I know many games that were released at such a level and are now polished and popular titles (or have faded into oblivion...). 


Today, many titles are released, also as indie games, which have little in common with indie games like ☵ HIRAETH, are polished, but on the other hand, they don't change much later. I approach Early Access as just the beginning of an adventure, and if you know the game's publishing plans - a lot will change during it!
Current assumptions:
In the first version, the survival sandbox mode is similar to the one currently in playtest. Then there will be tasks, quests and a story mode will gradually appear;

Training Center and The Nesoi Island with a gradual expansion of the area. There will be no separate locations, simply new areas with different specifics and landscape will appear in the game. I'm already preparing other areas, but vehicles need to be added, which will happen soon;

There will definitely be the option to set your own keys and controller support, as well as other settings that currently only work partially in playtest;

The language versions listed on the game's website will appear successively, as Early Access develops;

In Early Access there will be a full or partial option to choose the difficulty level;

Full underwater exploration. In playtest this is a new option, only some underwater parts have a design as such;

Much more crafting, repairs and scrapping;

Refined weather direction;

Much more environmental hazards (radiation, fire, etc.), and damage will be more realistic, adjusted to the selected difficulty level;

Steam Achievements, which are disabled by Steam in playtest. There are currently a few test ones in playtest, not connected to your account;

Challenge mode. Directed challenges separate from the main gameplay;

Perks - connected to challenges, will make the game easier at the next start. This is just a rough but somewhat realistic plan for Early Access. 

The full list will be revealed at release.

NOTE: Early Access release time is dependent on meeting the requirements to reach at least 10,000 wishlists on Steam.
Support creation now and become a legend in the ☵ Hiraeth game universe forever!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/4c1fc62b9ddbcba1c6273ff7d82f2ba05b17e3b6.png"]
This is a real Indie game, or rather solodev
Although many people warned me against presenting the game as an indie game and solo dev for marketing reasons, I believe that there is no point in hiding it and that things should be presented as they are. As you can see in the playtest, there are a few people in the game's credits. At the beginning of the work on the project, they did a lot of great work, but for 2 years I have been working on the project exclusively by myself and in all aspects.
What will your support be used for?
First of all, to continue working on the project, releasing the Early Access version. Mainly for basic needs and internet and energy bills. Working on the project takes 100% of my time, apart from the lack of private life, I also cannot take on additional paid work, which would have a disastrous effect on workflow;
If the support is greater - to join the team of other people. Many are willing, the problem is, for example, the lack of possibility to maintain the project server necessary for teamwork, which is expensive for such an extensive project.
How to support?
The game's website lists various methods:
Patreon, buymeacoffee and PayPal/HiraethGame.

Regardless of where you support, the rewards are equal - what counts is the amount of the payment (also cumulative), and in return you will receive different rewards. Keep your payment confirmation, it will be the basis for the reward - placing you in the game and the universe ☵ HIRAETH.

Preferred payment methods
It depends on your preferences, but please take into account:

PayPal is currently the fastest and least expensive way to receive support - for you and for me;

When paying with Apple Pay, the smallest part of your money is allocated to the project. There is also a 70-day grace period, so your support may not arrive on time...

For any questions - contact me directly, preferably on Discord or via the form at hiraethgame.com

When will you receive the rewards for your support?
Previous and current supporters receive rewards on an ongoing basis, with each game update. They are added to the game credits and placed in the game universe. They also appear on the game's website hiraethgame.com/support-production-and-be-part-of-hiraeth-game-universe/

Example rewards for different support levels:
Placement in in-game credits

Placement in the colonist list in the in-game databases

Memory Lane Polaroid - your photo on the memory walls

Name of the location or shelter, region

Mention in notes, item names

Separate mini stories or mini quests with a mention

And many more. I try to distinguish supporters without disturbing the immersion of the players, which is working well for now (supporters are already listed in playtest).
Until when?
Support in this form will be possible until the release of the Early Access version. The rewards will be counted up to that point, and then the places where you can support will be closed.
Perhaps some other possibility will appear, for example the DLC Supporter Pack, but this is an unknown future for now. Such potential DLC will be completely unnecessary to play and will only contain some vanity items, with no impact on gameplay. It will also not be tied to the “become a legend in the ☵ Hiraeth game universe forever” rewards, so now is your last chance!



Greetings to all survivors and see you in Early Access!

Paweł, author

notes.title: ☵ HIRAETH game update and plans
notes.content:
Hello players, game followers and playtest participants!
[previewyoutube=x3rlNfjYkKs;full][/previewyoutube]
I rarely post on the main game channel, but today's update is for everyone, not just our Playtest participants. Here's what we'll cover:

     Game and Playtest Status
     Release Plans, especially regarding Early Access
     Details on Our New Indiegogo Campaign
     Best Places to Stay Updated

Feel free to ask questions in this thread; I'm here to answer them all!
Game and playtest status
Development on ☵ HIRAETH continues with regular Steam Playtest updates. While I'm a solo developer, the pace matches that of larger teams due to the complexity involved.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/a2e562b4bb058f6377991d7e37d94a26b2ca0669.png
Remember, the Playtest version isn't a demo but a tool for refining the game, currently lacking full gameplay features and optimized for testing, not final user experience.
PROGRESS
Since our Kickstarter, we've introduced:

     Save/Load System: For player and world states.
     Dynamic Weather System: Including calendar-based events like sandstorms and blizzards.
     New Weapon System: With various weapons and ammo types.
     Enhanced AI: Including flying drones.
     First Vehicle: Among other unannounced updates.

Some of these features are in Playtest; others are slated for Early Access or beyond.
Release plans
As you can see on Steam the planned release date is 2024 and there is not much time left. Although this date is still valid, I want to release a game that is polished and interesting for you.
Early Access
Early Access will feature "ETERNAL" mode, an endless survival sandbox with diverse locations ranging from deserts to Arctic zones, each with unique challenges and biomes.
Full game
Full Game Release will follow Early Access, expanding on "ETERNAL" and introducing "REVELATIONS", a story mode with the first of five planned chapters.
Indiegogo campaign
We've just launched the pre-launch page for our Indiegogo campaign, aiming to fund further development and high-quality elements like a fully orchestral soundtrack by Michele Masin, known for his work on films like "1917" and "Midsommar." This campaign is crucial for hiring voice talent, like Andy Mack from "Dying Light 2" and for general game refinement. Support at this stage means exclusive perks at a fraction of the final game's cost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/96e05b7cfdb366387f6954ab720faace1ebcef3a.png
Why Indiegogo?
A lot of heart, sweat and blood went into ☵ HIRAETH. A lot has been done, but the success of the project lies in the details, which take time, and time is money. Every aspect of ☵ HIRAETH requires meticulous attention, from sound design to voice acting. Funds from Indiegogo will ensure these elements meet AAA standards, enhancing your experience significantly.
[previewyoutube=ZNz6EDQ7EBY;full][/previewyoutube]
There are still many necessary expenses – I'm sure they're all worth every cent!

I will allow myself to post new information about the Indiegogo campaign soon. I count on your support, even if it's just spread the word!
Thank you ːss2heartː
Stay Updated
For the latest on ☵ HIRAETH, follow our social media links below this post. For direct interaction, join our Discord community.

Thank you for your continued support and engagement. Spread the word, and let's make ☵ HIRAETH a game to remember!

notes.title: Today we are excited to announce the ☵ HIRAETH launch of our Kickstarter!
notes.content:
The Time Has Finally Come! 
Join us at Jade Horse Games as we launch our flagship title, ☵ HIRAETH on kickstarter. Kickstarter is a place where we can secure proper funding, build an expansive community, and all while rewarding backers for their amazing support with exclusive items and content. Donators can earn unique rewards, such as high tier donors being Immortalized in ☵ HIRAETH, and some backers can also gain access to exclusive tests, allowing their direct feedback to influence the gameplay. Each tier will feature unique rewards, benefits, and perks.

SUPPORT US NOW ON KICKSTARTER!
[previewyoutube=wiCtvfeWfTo;full][/previewyoutube]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hiraeth-game/hiraeth-sci-fi-survival-game-with-rich-story-pc-consoles

As we make our final preparations for our launch, we wanted to highlight this incredible journey some of us have been fortunate to be a part of. 

The Journey
☵ HIRAETH started as nothing more than a dream disguised as a gameplay test by our team lead. After he uploaded the small showcase, he received dozens of propositions, and within a few weeks, he found himself leading an ambitious team from around the globe. This was two years ago, and our team has been hard at work since. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/048cff425dfc8e868b8fd29125bcafa55e2ed1f3.gif

As our team has grown, so has our ambitious efforts to turn ☵ HIRAETH into the best survival game on the market. This kickstarter not only serves as a financial opportunity for the game and our team, but also as a symbol of our growth and continued efforts. So much time, work, funds, dedication, and heart has been poured into ☵ HIRAETH and it has all led our team here. As we stand on the edge of success, we can’t help but feel thankful for the opportunity and the community that has supported us along the way. This kickstarter campaign will build a path toward Early Access, propelling the game, community, and our team to new heights. 

Toward the Future 
It has been a long journey and we cannot wait to see where it takes us next. 

To know more about the Kickstarter campaign, the game, and more, we invite players to join our discord, which will have exclusive kickstarter rewards, and follow our various social handles.  We love hearing from interested players that want to explore the world of ☵ HIRAETH.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hiraeth-game/hiraeth-sci-fi-survival-game-with-rich-story-pc-consoles

notes.title: Community Matters! Let your feedback shape ☵ HIRAETH!
notes.content:
Salute to future survivors
We are working intensively on the release of the game, but in connection with the launch of the website on Steam, we are starting to work with the gaming community. We invite everyone willing to join our growing community - thanks to this, you will be kept informed about the plans and fate of the game, and your voice can shape the game over time! 

You can also support the development of the game. Your presence alone is a great help in popularizing the game, and if you are willing, you can also support us in other ways. This expanded support offers rewards, such as having your name featured within the game. Further details below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/4059e8abd5ba1fe826b88ea98d617bcf7a45c7d3.png
Join our community center – ☵ HIRAETH Discord. Thanks to your presence on our Discord, you will have access to first-hand information published on an ongoing basis.

Meet the creators
We also invite you to regular meetings with creators! The next one will take place on Friday, December 10 - details on ☵ HIRAETH Discord

Other news channels, social media
Please visit the game's official website. Being aware of current trends, we decided not to publish news here in favor of Discord and X/Twitter. You can also find us on other social platforms. 

You can find video reports on our YouTube including a devlog with early gameplay. More content is on the way, including sneak peaks of more gameplay and shorts.

Actively support the development of the game
We have been developing ☵ HIRAETH for over a year using our own funds and have independently reached the pre-Steam Playtest stage, which should take place soon.

Like many indie teams, any support is very important to us, especially at this stage. Simultaneously with the publication of the game's website on Steam, we launched a profile on Patreon.

Patreon
We've put a few support steps on Patreon. For $1 you can simply tell us that you like our work. Higher support will give you access to off-stage content, special Discord channels, free content, keys to the game and much more, including having your name featured within the game and website.

Kickstarter
We are currently preparing a kickstarter campaign, which should launch in the coming weeks. The kickstarter will be vital in achieving our goal to make Hiraeth the greatest survival experience. In order for that to happen, we require support, so that we can build and share our vision of Hiraeth.
